title: Glowing motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00e5ff' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#00e5ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='46' ry='34' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='70' r='15' fill='#1a1f3a'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='70' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='70' r='9' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.25'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='70' r='4' fill='#7dfaff'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='70' r='15' fill='#1a1f3a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='70' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='70' r='9' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.25'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='70' r='4' fill='#7dfaff'/>
  <!-- spokes -->
  <g stroke='#3ad8ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'>
    <line x1='24' y1='56' x2='24' y2='84'/>
    <line x1='10' y1='70' x2='38' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='76' y1='56' x2='76' y2='84'/>
    <line x1='62' y1='70' x2='90' y2='70'/>
  </g>
  <!-- frame -->
  <path d='M30 66 L48 44 L62 44 L80 64' fill='none' stroke='#ff5fa2' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M48 44 L52 66' fill='none' stroke='#ffb84d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 44 L58 66' fill='none' stroke='#ffb84d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- engine -->
  <rect x='46' y='55' width='16' height='12' rx='3' fill='#c04dff'/>
  <rect x='49' y='58' width='10' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- seat -->
  <path d='M44 40 Q56 34 66 38 L64 44 L46 44 Z' fill='#2e3554'/>
  <path d='M44 40 Q56 34 66 38' fill='none' stroke='#9b8cff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tank -->
  <path d='M58 40 Q70 38 72 46 Q64 48 58 44 Z' fill='#00b8d9'/>
  <!-- handlebars and fork -->
  <line x1='78' y1='34' x2='70' y2='48' stroke='#8ff0ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='34' x2='86' y2='30' stroke='#8ff0ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='29' r='2.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='50' r='4' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='50' r='7' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <path d='M52 66 L40 72' stroke='#b0b8d8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 72 L34 74' stroke='#ffb84d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
